requirement: Storefront lifecycle: new storefronts start as Pending Activation, can't go Active without at least one active menu and hours for all 7 days, suspended ones notify the account owner, and closed ones deactivate menus.

expect.notes: Default picklist value; Menu_Count__c counts all menus, not active ones — needs filtered roll-up or query; hours need 7 distinct days; cascade on close.
